merge_detection_retrieval_submission: run the script to merge detection and retrieval results into a submission JSON file
run_merge_with_output_path: run the script with an output path argument to pack detection and retrieval results
create_ego4d_submission_json: create an Ego4D moment queries submission JSON from detection and retrieval result files
